raw_response.study_a_sample_and_data: Qualitative ethnographic and theory-building multiple case study of three neighbourhoods and their community-based organizations (CBOs) in the metropolitan area of Cochabamba, Bolivia: Site A in Sacaba (297 households; service cooperative, initially a water committee), Site B in Quillacollo (215 households; OTB, initially a water committee), and Site C in Cercado (339 households; junta vecinal). Primary data were collected during 5 months in 2013 and 2 months in 2014 via observations, spontaneous ethnographic interviews, and 69 formally arranged audio-recorded interviews with 47 distinct informants (CBO leaders, members, and 3 cooperative employees at Site A), supplemented in early 2018 by 9 semi-structured follow-up interviews (3 per site).
